questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following statements is/are true about modes of formation of particulate matter?
questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is/are true about modes of formation of particulate matter?

options.html: Fumes are fine, solid particles formed by the condensation of vapors of solid materials.
options.text: Fumes are fine, solid particles formed by the condensation of vapors of solid materials.

options.html: Mist consists of liquid particles formed by the atomization of parent liquid.
options.text: Mist consists of liquid particles formed by the atomization of parent liquid.

options.html: Spray consists of liquid particles or droplets formed by the condensation of a vapor, the dispersion of a liquid or the enactment of a chemical reaction.
options.text: Spray consists of liquid particles or droplets formed by the condensation of a vapor, the dispersion of a liquid or the enactment of a chemical reaction.

options.html: Smokes are fine, solid particles resulting from incomplete combustion of organic particles.
options.text: Smokes are fine, solid particles resulting from incomplete combustion of organic particles.

questions.explanationHtml:
(a, d)
• Mist consists of liquid particles or droplets formed by the condensation of a vapor, the dispersion of a liquid, or the enactment of a chemical reaction.
• Spray consists of liquid particles formed by atomization of parent liquid.
